title: Pack manifest and registry, on and off in config
goal: A pack declares its tools, tables, chat phrases, Telegram captions and dashboard panels; config.json turns it on or off
acceptance: A pack switched off offers no tools to Misato, routes no chat phrases and shows no panel; its data stays
Core services (reminders, todos, timers, photos) are offered to packs through an interface
Join test across registry, planner tool list and dashboard API
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: manifest type, registry and config switch over the existing executor registry. Not a measurement.
